title: On Corresponding with the older map exactly
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：correspond　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 correspond 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the operator ① corresponded with the older map exactly at once, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② corresponds with the older map exactly in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ correspond with the older map exactly at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ corresponded with the older map exactly before — a line in the log for June 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Corresponding with the older map exactly at once, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ correspond with a cousin in the south in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Correspond with a cousin in the south at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ corresponds with a cousin in the south at once every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ corresponded with the older map exactly again when nobody else would.

⑩ To correspond with the older map exactly, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody corresponds with the older map exactly in the rain again and somebody must correspond with the older map exactly at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 相符（一般过去式 corresponded with the older map exactly：1963 年操作员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 相符（一般现在 corresponds with the older map exactly：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 相符（不定式 to correspond with the older map exactly：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 相符（过去完成时 had corresponded with the older map exactly：1957 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 相符（动名词 corresponding with the older map exactly 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 通信（correspond with a cousin in the south：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去通信与南方的一位表亲通信）
G. v. 通信（correspond with a cousin in the south：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 相符（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 corresponds with a cousin in the south，而母亲又一次 corresponded with the older map exactly）

answers.why: correspond 意为“相符”，1963 年操作员二话不说地相符与那张旧地图分毫不差，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 corresponded。
correspond 意为“相符”，自那以后操作员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 corresponds。
correspond 意为“相符”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯相符与那张旧地图分毫不差”，此处为不定式 to correspond with the older map exactly。
correspond 意为“相符”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1970 年之前就有人相符过，故用过去完成时 had corresponded。
correspond 意为“相符”，操作员说“相符与那张旧地图分毫不差这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 corresponding with the older map exactly 作主语。
correspond 意为“通信”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去通信与南方的一位表亲通信”，should ever 之后用原形 correspond with a cousin in the south。
correspond 意为“通信”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻通信与南方的一位表亲通信（correspond with a cousin in the south at once），以后再也不要提起。
correspond 意为“相符”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例通信与南方的一位表亲通信，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 corresponds。
correspond 意为“相符”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地相符与那张旧地图分毫不差，用一般过去式 corresponded 叙述。
correspond 意为“相符”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要相符与那张旧地图分毫不差，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1963 the operator corresponded with the older map exactly at once, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator corresponds with the older map exactly in the rain whenever the station asks.
Corresponding with the older map exactly at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever correspond with a cousin in the south in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.

When nobody else would, my mother corresponded with the older map exactly again, and the station remembered that half.
